svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a plate 94 mm long x 25 mm tall with a 26 mm long, 16 mm tall

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tab on its left end (top corner); fold the tab 90 degrees

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: toward the pack side: this is the flange that lies against the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside of the latch ear and carries the keeper.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill: two 4.5 mm holes for the hinge leaf, 18 mm each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the centre of the plate, 10 mm up; two 3.5 mm in the flange

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for the keeper's rivets, 4 and 8 mm from its end, 8 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue a 3 mm rubber pad, 80 x 16 mm, on the pack face, 8 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the hinge holds its lower edge 6 mm above the tray; closed,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the pad presses the pack's top end below the handle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Folded down, it lies flat under the pack's path.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it folds through 90 degrees without touching the pack.
